analogy.rationale: CNR2 is a Gi-coupled GPCR with low expression in most of these cell lines, so inverse agonists should elicit little transcriptional change, similar to other cannabinoid receptor ligands and GPCR antagonists; FAAH inhibitors and neuropeptide receptor antagonists share endocannabinoid/GPCR-related biology but are less directly comparable.
